<div align="center">

<!-- Top Wave -->
<img width="100%" src="https://capsule-render.vercel.app/api?type=waving&color=0:6C63FF,100:A78BFA&height=80&section=header" alt="Top Wave"/>

<svg width="1200" height="300" viewBox="0 0 1200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:c2pa="http://c2pa.org/manifest"><metadata><c2pa:manifest></c2pa:manifest></metadata>
<defs>
  <linearGradient id="skyBg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
    <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#07060f"/>
    <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#0d0a1f"/>
  </linearGradient>

  <radialGradient id="neb1" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
    <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#c084fc" stop-opacity="0.65"/>
    <stop offset="55%" stop-color="#7c3aed" stop-opacity="0.30"/>
    <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#7c3aed" stop-opacity="0"/>
  </radialGradient>
  <radialGradient id="neb2" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
    <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#f472b6" stop-opacity="0.55"/>
    <stop offset="55%" stop-color="#be185d" stop-opacity="0.25"/>
    <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#be185d" stop-opacity="0"/>
  </radialGradient>
  <radialGradient id="neb3" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
    <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#38bdf8" stop-opacity="0.55"/>
    <stop offset="55%" stop-color="#0369a1" stop-opacity="0.25"/>
    <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#0369a1" stop-opacity="0"/>
  </radialGradient>
  <radialGradient id="neb4" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
    <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#34d399" stop-opacity="0.35"/>
    <stop offset="55%" stop-color="#065f46" stop-opacity="0.18"/>
    <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#065f46" stop-opacity="0"/>
  </radialGradient>
  <radialGradient id="neb5" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
    <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#fbbf24" stop-opacity="0.30"/>
    <stop offset="55%" stop-color="#92400e" stop-opacity="0.15"/>
    <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#92400e" stop-opacity="0"/>
  </radialGradient>

  <filter id="nebulaBlur" x="-50%" y="-50%" width="200%" height="200%">
    <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="26"/>
  </filter>

  <filter id="hueShift" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
    <feColorMatrix type="hueRotate" values="0">
      <animate attributeName="values" from="0" to="360" dur="50s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </feColorMatrix>
  </filter>

  <linearGradient id="waterFlow" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse" x1="0" y1="0" x2="160" y2="0" spreadMethod="repeat">
    <stop offset="0%"  stop-color="#4C1D95"/>
    <stop offset="30%" stop-color="#8B5CF6"/>
    <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#F5F3FF"/>
    <stop offset="70%" stop-color="#8B5CF6"/>
    <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#4C1D95"/>
    <animateTransform attributeName="gradientTransform" type="translate"
      values="0 0; 160 0" dur="3.5s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </linearGradient>

  <filter id="glow" x="-60%" y="-60%" width="220%" height="220%">
    <feGaussianBlur in="SourceGraphic" stdDeviation="6" result="blur">
      <animate attributeName="stdDeviation" values="4;9;4" dur="3.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </feGaussianBlur>
    <feMerge>
      <feMergeNode in="blur"/>
      <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
    </feMerge>
  </filter>

  <filter id="starGlow" x="-200%" y="-200%" width="500%" height="500%">
    <feGaussianBlur in="SourceGraphic" stdDeviation="1.6" result="blur"/>
    <feMerge>
      <feMergeNode in="blur"/>
      <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
    </feMerge>
  </filter>

  <clipPath id="typeClip">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="0" height="30">
      <animate attributeName="width" values="0;460;460;0;0" keyTimes="0;0.55;0.85;0.92;1"
        dur="6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </rect>
  </clipPath>

  <linearGradient id="trail0" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0" gradientUnits="objectBoundingBox"><stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0"/><stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0.95"/></linearGradient><linearGradient id="trail1" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0" gradientUnits="objectBoundingBox"><stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0"/><stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0.95"/></linearGradient><linearGradient id="trail2" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0" gradientUnits="objectBoundingBox"><stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0"/><stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0.95"/></linearGradient><linearGradient id="trail3" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0" gradientUnits="objectBoundingBox"><stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0"/><stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0.95"/></linearGradient><linearGradient id="trail4" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0" gradientUnits="objectBoundingBox"><stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0"/><stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0.95"/></linearGradient>
